text: At 65’, Redmond Rovers executed a tactical shift to a higher press (press intensity from 0.82 to 1.0) and increased directness (0.48 to 0.63), raising their defensive line height to 0.9 in an attempt to chase the 1-2 deficit against Ironvale Athletic [#1190]. This pressing trigger disrupted Ironvale’s low block and deep defensive line, reflected in a sharp drop of opponent xG from 0.97 to 0.17, while Redmond’s field tilt surged from 60.0% to 80.6%, indicating effective territorial overload and positional advancement despite a possession drop (63.1% to 45.8%) [#1190]. However, the increased direct play and pressing slightly worsened Redmond’s PPDA from 5.2 to 6.0 and raised high turnovers (1 to 2), suggesting some risk in transition phases. The outcome was a marked rise in Redmond’s attacking threat (xG 0.28 to 0.91) and box touches (5 to 9) but no immediate goal conversion in the subsequent minutes [#1190].
